name: arbitration-tuning
_provenance: Johnny-trt.47 — the acceptance/tuning script: 10 by-name turns (5 per agent, interleaved) and 10 unaddressed turns. Run via `python -m johnny.agent.ensemble_scenario --scenario johnny/agent/fixtures/ensemble_arbitration.json [--redis]`; the evaluation asserts every by-name turn routed to exactly the named agent and every unaddressed turn produced exactly one answer (claim winner) with the loser terminalizing no_reply(peer_answered) — i.e. zero duplicates across all 20 turns (acceptance allows <=1).
